Definition: Integration of farmer registries, agricultural input vouchers, land registrations, extension services data
Comments: Rural Infrastructure Management GIS (for POSER - Programme for Promotion of Rural Socioeconomic Opportunities) operational, using NOSi infrastructure. Spatial data integrated. However, no specific farmer registry integrated with central exchange layer documented.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Confirmed. A February 2026 Ministry of Agriculture tender to upgrade and integrate the POSER GIS with its M&E software, and the July 2025 launch of the VI Agricultural Census (which explicitly aims to build a future 'Sistema Permanente de Inquéritos Agrícolas Integrados'), show agricultural data systems are still being built out rather than linked into a central exchange layer. No farmer-registry/PDEX integration was found. Score of 3 (Under development) stands, now with two additional corroborating sources.

Definition: Integration of company registration, business licensing, tax compliance, regulatory compliance data
Comments: One-Stop Investment Desk (BUI/JUI) is operational - "single platform that allows investors to interact with Public Administration, through a single window, to discuss investment issues in Cabo Verde, avoiding successive visits to various institutions" with 75-day maximum process. revision_notes: Revised down. The national Plataforma Empresa Online (PEO) — successor to the One-Stop Investment Desk cited in the original comment — is currently live only as a Beta 'available to a pilot group of users' (peo.gov.cv, checked 2026), and a 2024 Ministry of Finance terms-of-reference document confirms PDEX integration work for company creation/registration was still being built, not complete. Definition: Integration of CRVS data (births, deaths, marriages) into data exchange for real-time verification and service eligibility
Comments: NOSi operates a Civilian ID System that "collects and processes data from civil registries for birth, marriage, death and stillbirths, in a stream that connects civil registries and other information systems of the Government." This provides partial integration with the broader government infrastructure. The SNIAC directly connects to civil registry data.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Revised up. PDEX's own site (the government's primary data-exchange platform) states plainly that 'all integrations with the civil identification system are carried out through PDEX', ensuring interoperability and reliability of access to citizen data. This is direct primary-source evidence of complete integration of the civil identity/registry function into the central exchange, exceeding the 'partial' integration originally scored. Changed from 4 to 5.

The Ministry of Education's own site describes SIGE (Sistema de Informação e Gestão da Educação), covering attendance, grades and fees, and the 2022-2026 education strategic plan commits to further 'digitalização da gestão'. This is consistent with partial digitisation and integration of learner records rather than full integration with the central exchange (PDEX), for which no specific evidence was found. Definition: Integration of voter registration data for identity verification, demographic analysis, and service delivery targeting
Comments: NOSi operates an "Election Results Announcement Platform" that is described as "totally automated, transparent, and secure process which shares the results from polling stations." Electoral data shares CNI/digital ID infrastructure. Partial integration with core systems.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Revised down. The National Elections Commission (CNE) stated in December 2024 that the voter database dates from 2007 and is not updated or linked to modern civil-ID/SNIAC systems, and is publicly calling on government to introduce automatic voter registration ahead of the 2026 elections. This shows electoral-register integration with the identity system is a proposed reform, not a current partial reality; the original source (an election-results announcement tool) evidences results publication, not register integration. Changed from 4 to 2 (Planned).

Definition: Integration of job seeker registries, unemployment insurance, public employment programs, labor market information
Comments: SIGAE tracks scholarship/student data. INPS covers social insurance/employment contributions. However, no specific employment services or labor market information system integration with PDEX documented.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: No change, but flagged for human review. A newer aggregator site, IMPULSO.cv, now compiles job listings, IEFP training programmes (PAEF, PEPE) and INE labour-market data (2024) in one place, which might indicate movement beyond 'Planned'. However, it is unclear from available sources whether IMPULSO is an official government system or a private/donor-backed aggregator, and there is no evidence it is linked to PDEX or to an official jobseeker/unemployment-insurance registry. Recommend human review of IMPULSO's ownership and integration status before any upgrade from 2.

Comments: NOSi operates: (1) Health Information System (SIS) - integrated platform allowing different services to share clinical and administrative information with centralized repository; (2) WEBSIG National Observatory of Public Health with INE and INSP; (3) NHA CARD (Covid health passport/digital health certificate). 'Partially integrated' (4) stands.

Comments: WEBSIG National Observatory of Public Health collects statistical data from government sources. Business Intelligence systems for multiple sectors. NOSi provides data sharing between INE (National Statistics Institute) and government bodies. IGRP framework generates government reports from integrated databases.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Revised down. The National Statistics Council (CNEST) held a conference in April 2025 to launch Cabo Verde's first National Data Strategy, with its president stating that 'currently, much data is fragmented' — indicating cross-government statistical data sharing is still being designed, not yet operating as 'partially integrated' in practice. INE's own administrative-data project ('MasterData') was still under development as of 2024 per Statistics Portugal's COOPSTAT bulletin. Changed from 4 to 3 (Under development).

revision_notes: Flagged for human review, not confirmed either way.
